scope: All root round-1 findings touching 2SA 17–18; edited map rows and fixed-WEB source text captured below.

changedRows.sourceText: I will come on him while he is weary and exhausted, and will make him afraid. All the people who are with him will flee. I will strike the king only,
changedRows.reasonJa: 17:1でAhithophelが提案を始めた連続発話。him/the kingは直前の追跡対象Davidを指し、Iは話者Ahithophel。

changedRows.sourceText: and I will bring back all the people to you. The man whom you seek is as if all returned. All the people shall be in peace.”
changedRows.reasonJa: Ahithophelの連続発話。youは宛先Absalom、the man whom you seekはDavid、IはAhithophel。

changedRows.sourceText: Behold, he is now hidden in some pit, or in some other place. It will happen, when some of them have fallen at the first, that whoever hears it will say, ‘There is a slaughter among the people who follow Absalom!’
changedRows.reasonJa: 17:7以来のHushaiの連続発話。he=David、Absalomはfollowersの名に明示される。

changedRows.sourceText: Even he who is valiant, whose heart is as the heart of a lion, will utterly melt; for all Israel knows that your father is a mighty man, and those who are with him are valiant men.
changedRows.reasonJa: Hushaiの連続発話。your father/he/himはAbsalomの父David、youはAbsalom。Israelは本文に明記。

changedRows.sourceText: But I counsel that all Israel be gathered together to you, from Dan even to Beersheba, as the sand that is by the sea for multitude; and that you go to battle in your own person.
changedRows.reasonJa: Hushaiの連続発話。all Israel、Dan、Beershebaは明記。youは宛先Absalom、speakerはHushai。

changedRows.sourceText: So we will come on him in some place where he will be found, and we will light on him as the dew falls on the ground, then we will not leave so much as one of him and of all the men who are with him.
changedRows.reasonJa: Hushaiの連続発話。himは直前からのDavid。weは作戦の集団で、Absalomはその集団の一員と推定してリンクしない。

changedRows.sourceText: Moreover, if he has gone into a city, then all Israel will bring ropes to that city, and we will draw it into the river, until there isn’t one small stone found there.”
changedRows.reasonJa: Hushaiの連続発話。all Israelは明記、weは提案主体の集団。Absalomは含まれるとみなしてリンクしない。

changedRows.sourceText: Now therefore send quickly, and tell David, saying, ‘Don’t lodge tonight at the fords of the wilderness, but by all means pass over, lest the king be swallowed up, and all the people who are with him.’”
changedRows.reasonJa: 話者はHushai、命令の受け手は17:15のZadokとAbiathar。the kingは文脈上David。Absalomではない。

changedRows.sourceText: Now Jonathan and Ahimaaz were staying by En Rogel; and a female servant used to go and report to them, and they went and told King David; for they couldn’t risk being seen coming into the city.
changedRows.reasonJa: the cityはEn-rogelを出発点として危険を避ける目的地側の市街を指し、文脈上Jerusalem。固有名はこの節にないためcontext。

changedRows.sourceText: The woman took and spread the covering over the well’s mouth, and spread out crushed grain on it; and nothing was known.

unresolvedMentions.reasonJa: 井戸を覆った女性は無名で、17:17の別の匿名女性との同一性も示されない。

changedRows.reasonJa: 無名の女性と井戸は直前17:18のBahurimの家の中の井戸を受ける。女性の個人IDは作らない。

changedRows.sourceText: After they had departed, they came up out of the well and went and told King David; and they said to David, “Arise and pass quickly over the water; for thus has Ahithophel counseled against you.”
changedRows.reasonJa: theyは井戸から出たJonathanとAhimaaz。井戸はBahurimの家のもの（17:18–19）。「水」は特定河川名を本文で示さないのでJordanに結び付けない。

changedRows.sourceText: When Ahithophel saw that his counsel was not followed, he saddled his donkey, arose, and went home to his city, set his house in order, and hanged himself; and he died, and was buried in the tomb of his father.
changedRows.reasonJa: his cityはAhithophelの故郷Giloh（15:12で既出）。本文に町名は再掲されないためcontext。

changedRows.sourceText: Absalom set Amasa over the army instead of Joab. Now Amasa was the son of a man whose name was Ithra the Israelite, who went in to Abigail the daughter of Nahash, sister to Zeruiah, Joab’s mother.
changedRows.reasonJa: 本文はAmasaの母方を説明し、Ithraを「the Israelite」と直接呼ぶ。民族呼称としてperson:israel_682をdirectで採用。

changedRows.sourceText: When David had come to Mahanaim, Shobi the son of Nahash of Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and Machir the son of Ammiel of Lodebar, and Barzillai the Gileadite of Rogelim,

unresolvedMentions.reasonJa: 明示集団に適合する既存IDなし。

changedRows.reasonJa: LodebarはAmmielの出身地として明記。BarzillaiをGileaditeと呼び、Gilead由来の呼称も本文に明記。Mahanaim/Rabbah/Rogelimも明記。

changedRows.sourceText: brought beds, basins, earthen vessels, wheat, barley, meal, parched grain, beans, lentils, roasted grain,
changedRows.reasonJa: 物資の列挙は17:27のShobi・Machir・Barzillaiが持参したもの。Davidは次節17:29で明示されるため、この節に早出ししない。

changedRows.sourceText: honey, butter, sheep, and cheese of the herd, for David and for the people who were with him to eat; for they said, “The people are hungry, weary, and thirsty in the wilderness.”
changedRows.reasonJa: they saidは17:27–28の食料を届けたShobi・Machir・Barzillaiを受ける。Davidは本文に明記。

changedRows.sourceText: David sent the people out, a third part under the hand of Joab, and a third part under the hand of Abishai the son of Zeruiah, Joab’s brother, and a third part under the hand of Ittai the Gittite. The king said to the people, “I will also surely go out with you myself.”
changedRows.reasonJa: IttaiをGittiteと呼ぶ出身地由来の表現。既存ID Gathへの明示的な地名派生としてdirect。

changedRows.sourceText: But the people said, “You shall not go out, for if we flee away, they will not care for us, neither if half of us die, will they care for us. But you are worth ten thousand of us. Therefore now it is better that you are ready to help us out of the city.”
changedRows.reasonJa: the cityは直前17:24/27でDavidがいるMahanaimを指す。兵士たちはDavidに話しかけている。

changedRows.sourceText: The king said to them, “I will do what seems best to you.” The king stood beside the gate, and all the people went out by hundreds and by thousands.
changedRows.reasonJa: the kingはDavid、the gateは場面のMahanaimの門。両方とも直前のMahanaimの場面に限定したcontext。

changedRows.sourceText: So the people went out into the field against Israel; and the battle was in the forest of Ephraim.
changedRows.reasonJa: 「forest of Ephraim」は複合地名。Ephraim個人/部族を別個に言及する文ではない。Israelと森林地名を残す。

changedRows.sourceText: The people of Israel were struck there before David’s servants, and there was a great slaughter there that day of twenty thousand men.
changedRows.reasonJa: thereは直前18:6のforest of Ephraimを受ける。IsraelとDavid’s servantsは本文に明記。

changedRows.sourceText: Joab said to the man who told him, “Behold, you saw it, and why didn’t you strike him there to the ground? I would have given you ten pieces of silver and a sash.”
changedRows.reasonJa: Joabの「strike him」は直前18:10で見たAbsalomを指す。Joabは話者として明記。

changedRows.sourceText: Otherwise, if I had dealt falsely against his life (and there is no matter hidden from the king), then you yourself would have set yourself against me.”
changedRows.reasonJa: 話者は兵士、youはJoab、the kingはDavid、his life/the king’s sonはAbsalom。AbishaiとIttaiは前節の命令に現れるが、この発話の指示対象ではない。

changedRows.sourceText: Now Absalom in his lifetime had taken and reared up for himself the pillar which is in the king’s valley, for he said, “I have no son to keep my name in memory.” He called the pillar after his own name. It is called Absalom’s monument, to this day.

unresolvedMentions.reasonJa: 地名は明記されるが一致する既存地名IDを確認できず、Valley of Shavehとは同一視しない。Absalom’s monument自体の既存場所IDもない。

changedRows.reasonJa: Absalomと「the king’s valley」「Absalom’s monument」は本文に明記。ただし該当する既存場所IDがなく、Valley of Shavehとの同定は根拠不足で保留。

changedRows.sourceText: Joab said to him, “You must not be the bearer of news today, but you must carry news another day. But today you must carry no news, because the king’s son is dead.”
changedRows.reasonJa: Joabはhim=Ahimaazに話しかける。the king’s son is deadはAbsalom、the kingはDavid。

changedRows.sourceText: Then Joab said to the Cushite, “Go, tell the king what you have seen!” The Cushite bowed himself to Joab, and ran.
changedRows.reasonJa: Joabが「the Cushite」と呼ぶ使者が本文に明記される。これは無名の使者を表す既存IDであり固有名を補わない。王=Davidは一意なcontext。

changedRows.sourceText: Then Ahimaaz the son of Zadok said yet again to Joab, “But come what may, please let me also run after the Cushite.” Joab said, “Why do you want to run, my son, since you will have no reward for the news?”
changedRows.reasonJa: AhimaazとZadokは明記。the Cushiteは直前18:21の同じ使者で、Joabの指示の対象。

changedRows.sourceText: “But come what may,” he said, “I will run.” He said to him, “Run!” Then Ahimaaz ran by the way of the Plain, and outran the Cushite.
changedRows.reasonJa: Ahimaaz、the Cushiteは明記。he saidの話者Ahimaaz、he said “Run!”はJoabと会話文脈で特定できる。

changedRows.sourceText: Behold, the Cushite came. The Cushite said, “Good news for my lord the king, for the LORD has avenged you today of all those who rose up against you.”
changedRows.reasonJa: the Cushiteと「my lord the king」は明記。the king=Davidは明確なcontext。LORDは使者の発話中にあるが、神IDは別人物背景として挿入しない（固有名・実照応対象の記録方針）。

changedRows.sourceText: The king said to the Cushite, “Is it well with the young man Absalom?” The Cushite answered, “May the enemies of my lord the king, and all who rise up against you to do you harm, be as that young man is.”
changedRows.reasonJa: Davidがthe Cushiteに問い、Absalomは名前で明記。使者は本文の話者として再出し。Godは本文に現れないため除去。

notesJa: 指摘のあった各節は現行map本文を固定WEBの節/直前文脈と照合した。継続発話の話者、発話の相手、明確な先行詞、文字どおりの民族由来/地名を補い、森林名からEphraim個人を誤分離した行、Abishai/IttaiやGodの背景挿入を除去した。King’s Valleyは既存Valley of Shavehと同一視せず、未対応の地名として保留。各根拠は節別reasonJaに記録。
elapsedReasonJa: 実作業時間は計測していないため推定しない。

latestDelta.reasonJa: Ahithophel’s city is the existing Giloh profile from 15:12.
